name: O'BRIEN, Edward (Ted) Lynam

headline.note: Private business roles are supported but full-time hours, leave and several employer boundaries remain unknown. Follow-up narrows Barton Deakin to self-reportedNovember2011–November2012 and consultancy startFebruary2014. ABN/GST dates remain registration context only. More than half advisory services reportedly pro bono; no FTE inferred. Governance, study, unpaid activities and elected office are excluded; no public/private total calculated.

career_spells.role: Marketing and Administrative Officer; Operations and Business Development Manager, Asia Pacific; Country Manager, Taiwan
career_spells.evidence_note: The official biography lists both roles and O'Brien's profiles describe progression to senior management in Asia. No dates, hours, leave, exact employing entity or role boundary are supplied. Indexed Queensland parliamentary paper4896T275 additionally identifies him as Defiance Marketing and Administrative Officer and discusses a Taiwan bakery-goods venture with Elite Food. Exact observation date and relationship to the other Defiance titles remain unverified; no separate or overlapping duration is manufactured.
career_spells.counting_note: Senior titles and ordering do not prove a full-time interval.

career_spells.evidence_note: Official and member biographies identify Asian business-development work for the rice cooperative, including international negotiations and market-entry work, but publish no dates, hours or leave.
career_spells.counting_note: No countable full-time interval is established.

career_spells.role: Strategy consulting and service delivery; Market Maker Lead, Greater China; Director of Growth and Strategy, Asia Pacific and Emerging Markets
career_spells.evidence_note: O'Brien says he spent more than ten years at Accenture, starting in Sydney strategy consulting and ending in Beijing as Director of Growth and Strategy; the official biography lists Market Maker Lead and Director roles. No start/end dates, role boundaries, hours, leave or secondments are published. ABC2013candidate profile dates promotion to the Market Maker team to2005 after four strategy years. This dates a role transition, not an exact overall start; no backward subtraction or hours inference.
career_spells.counting_note: An aggregate duration and senior titles do not establish exact continuous full-time intervals.

career_spells.counting_note: A year-level outer interval is supported, but exact continuous full-time service is not.

career_spells.employer: Ted O'Brien & Associates / Visible Hand Consulting (Edward Lynam O'Brien, sole trader)
career_spells.evidence_note: Self-reported public professional profile gives Ted O’Brien & Associates commencement February2014. ABR records ABN/GST1December2013–6July2016 and business names Visible Hand5December2013 and Ted O’Brien & Associates11January2014: these are registration facts, not personal working boundaries. career_spells.counting_note: Do not treat ABN/GST life as paid full-time service or infer four days of actual parliamentary overlap. Pro bono share cannot be translated into FTE; paid/unpaid client allocation and cessation unresolved.
